title: Brightpath CRM — Role in a Cookie
objective: You're a regular CRM user. Reach the administrator-only customer export without anyone granting you the admin role.

verifier.condition: The admin customer export is served to a session whose real account role is 'user', because the request carried a client-modified role value.

weakness: The server decides who is an administrator from a plain, client-controlled cookie instead of from its own record of the account.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /admin/customers (role read from an unsigned cookie)
seededData: Users alice (role user) and an admin account; a few synthetic customer records. In-memory.

credentials.label: Sales user
credentials.note: A regular user — the Admin link is hidden for you.

hints: After signing in, look at every cookie the application sets. Which of them describe you, rather than just identify a session?
Cookies live in your browser — you decide what your browser sends back.
burpNotes: Inspect the Set-Cookie headers on the login response in Proxy history, then experiment with the cookie values your browser sends back. Cookie names end in the lab's port number.
